clauses.reason: Terminated by its own terms. The operative sentence exempts Hubert K. Bishop from compulsory retirement for age for a period of one year and fixes the last day: "one year ending June 30, 1942". The end is recorded as 1942-06-30, inclusive (the exemption runs through that day, per the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on stated end dates); the exclusive reading, under which the exemption ends when that day begins, is the alternative a reviewer should see. The recital explains why the exemption is wanted and adds no separate command. The earlier exemption orders recited in the text are earlier instruments and do not bear on this order's end. The packet's searches (number citations, Federal Register catalog notes, person-name search) show no later order that changes the period or ends the exemption earlier; see the order-level checks. MOMMSEN-I recheck: Own APP fot / GPO for; obvious spelling error. Unselected predecessor EO 8413 APP gives ending June 30, 1041, while GPO gives 1941. Its material error remains unconfirmed; it supplies no first end or later event for this order. This order independently grants a year ending June 30, 1942.
